question: Where is the great liṅga of the primordial lord established in this sacred site?
premises: A great liṅga is associated with the primordial lord.
This liṅga is established in a specific location.
inference: The great liṅga of the primordial lord is established in the eastern part.
plain_english: The great liṅga of the primordial lord is established in the eastern part.
